title: NodeHardware (gateway acceptance rule)
description: What a gateway MUST accept in the optional `hardware` member of POST /v1/node/register (specs/47_NODE_JOIN_AND_HARDWARE_REGISTRATION.md section 3). Deliberately minimal: a JSON object with an integer `version`. Every other member, known or unknown, is stored verbatim and never validated by the gateway, so a mistyped known field is NOT grounds for refusal. The 65536-byte limit is a size rule and cannot be expressed here; the conformance vectors carry it. Producers should validate against node-hardware-report.json instead.

version.description: Layout version of the report. Producers send 1. A gateway accepts any JSON integer in the signed 64-bit range.
